## Ready, set, plan

Our event ready resources and expert guidance will help you plan a memorable event with confidence.

Book event spacesBook guest roomsCreate Attendee WebsiteNew to planning?EventReady Playbook

### Find the right venue

![Ballroom](https://www.hilton.com/im/en/BNALECI/17399324/conrad-ballroom.jpg?impolicy=crop&cw=5000&ch=3333&gravity=NorthWest&xposition=0&yposition=-1&rw=3840&rh=2562)

When you find a venue you like, you can contact the hotel directly or fill out a Pricing Request form online. It’s a good idea to have a few dates in mind, so you can compare your options.

[Explore event space](https://groups.hilton.com/guest-events?cid=OH,WW,SearchEventSpace,MULTIPR,tabs1,Landing,Events-Events)

### Reserve room blocks

![Woman sitting in guest room using laptop](https://www.hilton.com/im/en/ATLWCSA/21585555/hilton-h4b-suite-landscape-jpeg-3.jpg?impolicy=crop&cw=4662&ch=3107&gravity=NorthWest&xposition=0&yposition=194&rw=3840&rh=2562)

Once you know how many guests to expect, booking a block of rooms is easy. You can book and confirm up to 25 guest rooms online.

If you need more than 25 rooms, contact the hotel directly or submit a pricing request.

[Book guest rooms](https://groups.hilton.com/guest-events?location_name=New+York%2C+New+York%2C+US&latitude=40.757995&longitude=-73.985626&brand_code=HH&country_code=US&room_count=10&tenant_config_id=51e0cf8d-e6c4-4727-8f54-42cde32e48e9&cid=OH,WW,SearchGuestRooms,MULTIPR,tabs1,Landing,Events-Events)

### Create a custom website

![Woman sitting at table and chairs working on laptop](https://www.hilton.com/im/en/REKPSQQ/21501426/qq-parliament-4079-r4v1.3.tif?impolicy=crop&cw=5000&ch=3333&gravity=NorthWest&xposition=0&yposition=1&rw=3840&rh=2562)

After booking your space and rooms, create a customer Attendee Website to share with your guests where they can access event details and book their own rooms with ease.

[Learn about Attendee Websites](https://www.hilton.com/en/events/attendee-website/?cid=OH,WW,AttendeeWebsite,MULTIPR,tabs1,Landing,Events-Events)
